footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Shentel: includes an $8.9M income tax benefit; after $6.4M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 9.1% to $358M in 2025. Gross margin was 26.9%, versus 30.8% a year earlier, and the operating loss narrowed to $23.2M from $28.6M.

The company had a net loss of $39.4M, or −$0.71 per share, versus net income of $190M. Operating cash flow was $101M and free cash flow −$258M, versus −$257M; Shentel returned $6.4M through dividends.
sources: Shenandoah Telecommunications Company Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
